summary: S3StorageBackend is one boto3-based class registered for five provider types (S3, S3EXPRESS, R2, MINIO, B2); flavor differences are resolved by S3Connection, not here. It implements StorageReadProtocol (S3ReadMixin), StorageWriteProtocol (S3WriteMixin), StorageEnumerateProtocol (S3EnumerateMixin), StorageDeleteProtocol (S3DeleteMixin), StorageMetadataProtocol (S3MetadataMixin), StorageCopyProtocol (S3CopyMixin, server-side copy_object) and, structurally via S3ReadMixin.open_ranged, RangedReadProtocol. StorageDirectoryProtocol is intentionally not implemented. botocore errors are mapped to typed StorageError subclasses.
key_classes: S3StorageBackend — unified S3-family backend over an injected S3Connection's boto3 client; connect/disconnect/is_connected manage the cached client
S3ReadMixin — StorageReadProtocol: get_object reads, forward-only stream, plus open_ranged (HEAD for size, ranged GET with IfMatch on strong ETag)
S3WriteMixin — StorageWriteProtocol: put_object for bytes, upload_fileobj (multipart-aware, non-buffering) for streams; create_parents ignored
S3EnumerateMixin — StorageEnumerateProtocol: list_objects_v2 paginator, literal key prefixes, optional delimiter, CommonPrefixes as PREFIX entries
S3MetadataMixin — StorageMetadataProtocol: head_object metadata with checksum preference SHA256 > CRC32C > CRC32 > SHA1; bucket-root existence via list_objects_v2
S3CopyMixin — StorageCopyProtocol: server-side copy_object within the same client
R2StorageBackend / S3ExpressStorageBackend / MinIOStorageBackend / B2StorageBackend — backwards-compatible aliases of S3StorageBackend
key_functions: s3_path.parse_s3_path(path) -> tuple[str, str] — accepts s3://bucket/key or bucket/key; raises MissingExtraError without [http] and ValueError on invalid paths
_helpers._map_error(exc, path) -> StorageError | None — ClientError code/status, credential, connection and botocore errors to typed errors; SDK validation errors stay native
extension_points: Mixins explicitly subclass the storage protocols and expect self._client; they can be recomposed for another boto3-compatible store.
New S3-compatible flavors are added via S3StorageProfile FLAVOR and S3Connection plus another @register_storage_backend line, not a new class.
lifecycle_notes: Client is borrowed from the injected S3Connection: bound at __init__ if already connected, else via connect(); disconnect() only drops the cached reference and does not close the connection (facade owns it).
botocore is imported lazily inside _map_error and path parsing needs the [http] stack; actual use needs the [s3] extra.
read_to_stream returns a forward-only stream the caller must close; open_ranged issues one HEAD then a GET per range.
documentation_hooks: Support matrix row: S3 family = Read, Write, Enumerate, Delete, Metadata, Copy, RangedRead; no Directory.
S3 flavors guide: one backend class, five registrations, flavor resolved by connection.
S3 prefix enumeration semantics and max_results behaviour (no early pagination termination).
Random access on S3 (HEAD + ranged GET, If-Match ETag pinning, ObjectChangedError).
Error mapping table for botocore ClientError codes.
examples: examples/storage_profiles/README.md — S3StorageProfile flavors that select this backend
examples/path_dispatch/README.md — s3:// and related schemes dispatching to the S3 family
risks: S3EnumerateMixin.list_objects consumes all pages before applying max_results, so a small limit on a large prefix still lists everything (README.md acknowledges no early pagination termination).
S3CopyMixin.copy uses a single copy_object call; AWS documents a 5 GB limit for CopyObject, and no multipart copy fallback exists here (limit not verified in this repo).
Native copy only works within one client/credential set; cross-account or cross-flavor copies go through copy_between's stream path.
RangedReadProtocol support is structural (open_ranged on S3ReadMixin) and not mentioned in the S3StorageBackend docstring.
Module docstring and alias comment refer to 'deleted storage_backends.r2' shim modules; no such modules exist under src/, and no test imports the aliases.
open_questions: Are the R2/S3Express/MinIO/B2 StorageBackend aliases still a supported public surface, or deprecated candidates for removal?

evidence.detail: Five @register_storage_backend decorators on S3StorageBackend(S3ReadMixin, S3WriteMixin, S3EnumerateMixin, S3DeleteMixin, S3MetadataMixin, S3CopyMixin); docstring states Directory intentionally not implemented.
Paginates fully then truncates to max_results.
S3 object-prefix enumeration section documents literal prefixes and no early pagination termination.
